_note: Russian; see topbar.json. The notices list (its button, Clear All, Reload and Keep mine, the strip under a song changed outside), and everything put in a notice or a refusal cue: imports, song packs, bundles, presentations, themes and versions, the library's moves and saves, errors shown in the window, the Settings and Screens windows' titles. A file's name usually leads with a colon («{name}: …») so it never has to take a case; «» only where the English quotes a name (the code quotes some names itself).
